body:
## Summary

The current SchemaStore `uv.json` schema is missing `malware-check` and `malware-check-url` under `[tool.uv.audit]`, although both settings are officially supported by uv, documented, and already included in the generated `uv.schema.json`.

Specifically, both properties are missing from the `AuditOptions` schema definition.

Please update the published SchemaStore schema to recognize both settings and provide proper autocompletion and type validation in editors.

## Usage

The following valid configuration in `pyproject.toml` should be fully supported by SchemaStore:

```toml
[tool.uv.audit]
malware-check = true
malware-check-url = "https://example.com"
```

The schema should recognize:

- `malware-check`: Boolean.
- `malware-check-url`: URL string.

## References

- #20587
title: Update SchemaStore `uv.json` to include `audit.malware-check` and `audit.malware-check-url`
